title: Equipment
seoTitle: Excavation Equipment & Crews, BC | Neil Smith Construction
description: Excavators, mini excavators, dozers, compaction, dump trucks and trench shoring run by NSC crews on civil and excavation work across Metro Vancouver.

hero.title: Equipment and fleet.
hero.subtitle: Our crews run their own excavators, compaction equipment, trucks and shoring, from our equipment yard in Langley to job sites across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley.

image.alt: Three NSC excavators, Kobelco, CAT 336D and Doosan, lined up on an excavation site

items.title: Excavators
items.text: CAT and Kobelco excavators for bulk excavation, utility trenches, pipe laying and setting manholes, chambers and detention tanks.

items.title: Mini and compact excavators
items.text: Compact machines for tight school sites, building perimeters, service trenches and work beside occupied buildings.

items.title: Backhoes and breakers
items.text: Backhoes with breaker attachments for concrete and asphalt removal, service connections and small excavations.

items.title: Dozers and skid steers
items.text: Site grading, stripping, spreading granular base and building pads.

items.title: Compaction
items.text: Drum compactors and plate compactors for subgrade, granular base, trench backfill and building pads.

items.title: Trucks, dumpers and trailers
items.text: Dump trucks, site dumpers, flat deck trucks and trailers and a pony trailer for hauling, material supply and moving equipment between sites.

items.title: Trench shoring
items.text: Trench boxes and shoring for deep utility trenches and manhole excavations, so crews work safely below grade.

items.title: GPS grade control
items.text: Trimble GPS grade control and grade checkers on site for accurate excavation, pads and pipe grades.

items.title: Equipment yard
items.text: Machines and materials are based at our equipment yard in Langley, close to jobs across the Lower Mainland.

items.q: Does Neil Smith Construction use its own equipment?
items.a: Yes. Our crews run their own excavators, compaction equipment, trucks and trench shoring, based at our equipment yard in Langley.

items.q: Can you work on tight school and urban sites?
items.a: Yes. We use mini and compact excavators and plan access, hauling and shoring around occupied schools, fire halls and streets. See [School site works](school-site-works.html).

items.q: Do you use GPS grade control?
items.a: Yes. Trimble GPS grade control and grade checkers are used on site for excavation, building pads and pipe grades.
